definitions.explanation: A spiral-shaped incense that repels mosquitoes when burned.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Mosquito coils are essential in summer.

examples.japanese: {蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}を{焚|た}いて{寝|ね}る。
examples.english: I burn a mosquito coil and go to sleep.

examples.japanese: {蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}の{香|かお}りは{夏|なつ}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}だ。
examples.english: The smell of mosquito coils is a sign of summer.

notes:
FORMATION:
{蚊|か} (mosquito) + {取|と}り (repelling) + {線香|せんこう} (incense)

USAGE:
・{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}を{焚|た}く (to burn a mosquito coil)
・{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}を{立|た}てる (to light a mosquito coil)
・{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}{立|た}て (mosquito coil holder - pig-shaped ones are iconic)

CULTURE:
{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう} is closely associated with Japanese summer. The distinctive green spiral coil and its smoke are nostalgic symbols. Traditional holders are often shaped like pigs ({蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}).

MODERN ALTERNATIVES:
・{電気|でんき}{蚊取|かと}り (electric mosquito repellent)
・{蚊取|かと}りマット (mosquito mat)
・{液体|えきたい}{蚊取|かと}り (liquid mosquito repellent)
